messages:
Elena (BrightWorks): Hey team — during our onboarding tests the web app hits 429s on the SDK preflight when multiple tabs open. Happening only on staging keys.
Asha Kapoor: Sorry you're seeing that — can you paste a short repro? is this the browser SDK or server SDK?
Elena (BrightWorks): Browser SDK. Each tab does an init which triggers a /v1/preflight. If I open 4–6 tabs quickly we get bursts of 429. snippet: `await RedwoodSDK.init({ apiKey: 'stg_XXXXX', env: 'multi-tenant' })`
Devon Li: Thanks — that sounds like parallel preflight fanout. Do the 429 responses include a header like `x-rate-limit-type` or an `x-request-id`? Also, what SDK version?
Elena (BrightWorks): SDK v0.10.3. Sample response body: `{ "error": "rate_limited", "reason": "preflight_concurrency" }` no request-id in the Cloudflare logs we pulled.
Ravi Menon: Quick note from infra: our gateway rate-limits preflight by api_key with a short burst window to protect auth backend. That can hit client side when many tabs do full handshakes at once.
onboard-bot: New trial: BrightWorks started trial at 2026-03-19 14:02 UTC
Asha Kapoor: Two immediate mitigation options: 1) enable client-side preflight debounce/cache (temporary SDK flag) so concurrent in-page inits reuse the same preflight, or 2) issue ephemeral session tokens server-side and have each tab reuse them rather than re-running preflight. Ravi — can we also do a one-day whitelist for their staging key while they onboard?
Ravi Menon: We can authorize a short-term higher burst for the specific staging api_key. I'll need the exact key and a justification. Also we should consider adjusting the limiter from api_key -> session_id for browser flows in the near-term.
Devon Li: For repro / logs, can you run this from the console in a tab and paste the output? `fetch("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/preflight", { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer stg_XXXXX', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({client: 'browser'}) }).then(r => r.text()).then(console.log)`
Elena (BrightWorks): Ran it 5x quickly — got 3x 200, 2x 429. Raw responses: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2026 14:12:08 GMT
content-type: application/json
x-rate-limit-type: preflight-window

{"error":"rate_limited","retry_after_ms":1200}
```
Asha Kapoor: Perfect — thanks. Elena, I'll schedule a 30-min call with Dev/Platform to walk through a short repro and enable the temporary whitelist. Can you DM the staging key to me?
Elena (BrightWorks): Sent key via DM. Also happy to join the call now if available.
Ravi Menon: Received key. I'll provision a one-day burst increase for stg_XXXXX and follow up with audit logs. Also filing a short ticket to consider session-scoped limiter for browser SDK flows.
Devon Li: Follow-up: we'll put a `preflightCache: true` toggle in the SDK patch (v0.10.4) so in-page concurrency is deduped. Temporary workaround for you is to set `window.__RW_PRELIGHT_LOCK = true` before init in your app so tabs share an in-memory lock if you control the app code.
Elena (BrightWorks): Great — thanks team, will re-run and report back. :thumbsup:
Asha Kapoor: Thanks Elena — I'll send calendar invite for the triage and confirm when whitelist is active.
Devon Li: Leaving a note for release: add small doc blurb under "browser SDK best practices" about preflight debounce.
Elena (BrightWorks): Re-tested after whitelist — no 429s on 6 concurrent tabs. Appreciate the quick help!
